```yaml
name: Test and Validate

on:
  push:
    branches: [ main ]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ main ]

jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      matrix:
        python-version: [3.10, 3.11, 3.12]

    steps:
    - uses: actions/checkout@v4

    - name: Set up Python ${{ matrix.python-version }}
      uses: actions/setup-python@v4
      with:
        python-version: ${{ matrix.python-version }}

    - name: Install dependencies
      run: |
        python -m pip install --upgrade pip
        pip install -e .
        pip install pytest respx ruff

    - name: Run tests with pytest
      run: |
        pytest --verbose

    - name: Lint with ruff
      run: |
        ruff check .

    - name: Type check with mypy
      run: |
        mypy datagov_mcp/

  visualize:
    needs: test
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
    - uses: actions/checkout@v4

    - name: Set up Python
      uses: actions/setup-python@v4
      with:
        python-version: '3.11'

    - name: Install dependencies
      run: |
        python -m pip install --upgrade pip
        pip install -e .

    - name: Test visualization tools
      run: |
        python -c "
        from datagov_mcp.visualization import dataset_profile, chart_generator, map_generator
        print('Visualization tools imported successfully')
        "
```
